annotations.text:
1 · The page view end to end

Sticky top bar carries breadcrumb, edited-by, presence, comments count, Share, ★ and ⋯. Quiet affordances above the title. Description under it. Page details block, then the body aligned with the title.

Trade-off: the bar takes 44px from the reading area; on a phone it collapses to four targets.

2 · Top bar states

Editor, viewer (Read only pill, no Share), and the shipped save indicator. Hovering "Edited …" shows the full timestamp and a link to page history (history exists in the DB already, 90 days).

Deep trails collapse the middle to "…" and keep the parent and the page.

3 · Page details

Created by and Last edited are on by default and can be hidden per page. Five addable types: People, Date, Type, Link, Text. Hidden rows stay listed under "Add a property" so nothing is lost.

Trade-off: the brief lists properties as v2. This is a bounded jsonb column designed to lift into v2 databases; not a database.

4 · Sub-pages list

On any page with children. All / Mine / Recently edited come from created_by and updated_at, which pages already carry. "New sub-page" is the one primary action. Not a database view: no filters, no groups, no schema.

5 · Sidebar

Collapse with hover-to-peek (⌘\), Home and Templates as named rows, relative times on Recent, child counts, ⋯ and + on hover as shipped.

6 · Phone

44px targets, parent crumb as a back link, ★ and ⋯ only. Details collapse to a single line that expands on tap.
